info.name: Online Job Fair Registration API
info.description:
Project #3 - Online Job Fair Registration.

Run the whole collection in order (Runner or `newman run`). It registers its own admin and two users with unique emails each run, so it does not depend on existing data. The last folder deletes the companies it created (which also deletes their interview sessions).

Interview dates must be during May 10th - 13th, 2022. A user may book at most 3 interview sessions.

item.name: 1. Register
item.description: Req 1: register with name, telephone number, email and password.

item.name: 2. Login / Logout
item.description: Req 2: log in with email and password; log out.

item.name: 3a. Companies
item.description: Req 3: the company list is provided. Company info: name, address, website, description, telephone number. Only admin can manage companies.

item.name: 3b. Book Interview Sessions
item.description: Req 3: book up to 3 interview sessions, dated May 10th - 13th, 2022, with preferred companies.

item.name: 4-6. User manages own bookings
item.description: Req 4-6: the registered user views, edits and deletes their own interview sessions, and cannot touch other users' bookings.

item.name: Edit my interview to date outside fair (expect 400)
7-9. Admin manages any booking
item.description: Req 7-9: the admin views, edits and deletes any interview session.

item.name: Cleanup
item.description: Deletes the companies created by this run. Their remaining interview sessions are deleted with them.
